title: Introduction to Virtual Environments and pip
description: Understand how to create isolated Python environments and manage packages efficiently using pip.

lessons.title: What is pip?
lessons.content: pip is Python's package installer used to install and manage software packages written in Python from the Python Package Index (PyPI).

lessons.title: Installing Packages with pip
lessons.content:
Install a package using pip:
```
pip install package_name
```

lessons.title: Upgrading and Uninstalling Packages
lessons.content:
Upgrade a package:
```
pip install --upgrade package_name
```
Uninstall a package:
```
pip uninstall package_name
```

lessons.title: What are Virtual Environments?
lessons.content: Virtual environments create isolated Python environments for different projects to avoid dependency conflicts.

lessons.title: Creating a Virtual Environment
lessons.content:
Create a virtual environment:
```
python -m venv env_name
```

lessons.title: Activating a Virtual Environment
lessons.content:
Activate on Windows:
```
env_name\Scripts\activate
```
Activate on Mac/Linux:
```
source env_name/bin/activate
```

lessons.title: Using pip inside Virtual Environments
lessons.content: Inside a virtual environment, pip installs packages locally without affecting global Python installations.

lessons.title: Managing Project Dependencies
lessons.content:
Freeze dependencies:
```
pip freeze > requirements.txt
```
Install dependencies:
```
pip install -r requirements.txt
```

lessons.title: Best Practices for Virtual Environments and pip
lessons.content: Always use virtual environments per project, keep pip updated, regularly freeze dependencies, and avoid installing unnecessary packages globally.
